name: docs-layout
title: Docs Layout
description: DocsLayout, an app shell for documentation: a topbar slot, a sidebar that sticks under it at the full remaining height (a drawer on narrow screens), a breadcrumb slot above the page in the main column, the main landmark and a sticky table of contents. Also DocsToc (headings marked as you read with IntersectionObserver), DocsPager and DocsBreadcrumb.
docs: Compose the shell from a Topbar and a Sidebar that share one controller: `const sidebar = useSidebarState({ storageKey: "docs-sidebar" })`, then `<DocsLayout topbar={<Topbar leading={<SidebarTrigger {...sidebar.triggerProps} />} brand={…} trailing={…} />} sidebar={<Sidebar label="Documentation" {...sidebar.sidebarProps} collapse="hide" trigger={false} narrowQuery="(width <= 47.5rem)">…</Sidebar>} header={<DocsBreadcrumb items={…} />} toc={<DocsToc items={headings} />}>…</DocsLayout>`. The topbar sticks to the top; the sidebar sticks under it (`top: var(--topbar-height)`) at the full remaining height and scrolls on its own; elements with an `id` in the page scroll into view below the topbar. The trigger collapses the sidebar on wide screens and opens its drawer on narrow ones. Without a `topbar`, pass `--docs-top` in `style` to clear a fixed header of your own.
